standard_prerequisites.name: For a proper morphism of finite presentation with F of finite presentation flat over S, the derived pushforward K = Rf_*F is a perfect complex whose formation commutes with arbitrary base change
standard_prerequisites.use: Turns the geometric statement into a statement about a perfect complex on S.

standard_prerequisites.name: For a perfect complex on S the dimension functions of the cohomology of its derived fibers are upper semicontinuous with constructible level sets compatible with base change
standard_prerequisites.use: Supplies all three assertions (1), (2), (3) for the fiber cohomology dimensions.

core_obligations: By cohomology and base change, more precisely by Lemma flat-proper-perfect-direct-image-general, the object K = Rf_*F is a perfect object of the derived category of S whose formation commutes with arbitrary base change (proof lines 8165-8171).

In particular the fiber cohomology is H^i(X_s, F_s) = H^i(K tensor^L_O_S kappa(s)); the three assertions of the lemma then follow from Lemma jump-loci applied to the perfect complex K (proof lines 8171-8176).
proof_roadmap: Identify K = Rf_*F as perfect with base change compatibility (proof lines 8165-8171).
Read the fiber cohomology as the cohomology of the derived fiber of K and apply the jump loci lemma (proof lines 8171-8176).
